notes: World height spans Y=-64 (bedrock) to Y=320 (sky limit). Total height: 384 blocks.
Below Y=0, stone becomes deepslate — takes significantly longer to mine. Bring an iron pickaxe minimum.
Old Y=11 diamond advice is obsolete since the 1.18 Caves & Cliffs update.
Fortune III increases drops for: coal, redstone, lapis, diamond, emerald, nether gold, nether quartz, copper. Does NOT affect iron, gold ingots, or ancient debris.
Using the wrong pickaxe tier on an ore destroys the block without dropping anything.

pickaxe_tiers.stone: Copper, iron, lapis lazuli, nether quartz, nether gold

overworld_ores.notes: Most common ore. Also exposed on mountain surfaces — great for early game. Logs can substitute as furnace fuel but coal is far more efficient.
Very common. Spawns in larger veins in Dripstone cave biomes. Oxidizes over time, changing color from orange to green.

Two distinct peaks. Y=16 for underground mining; Y=232 for mountain biomes where iron veins are exposed on the surface. Check mountain peaks early game for fast iron. Bonus spawns in Stony Peaks biome.
Required to use the enchanting table. Slightly more common in Snowy biomes. Spawns as single blocks or small clusters.

Huge bonus spawn rate in Badlands biome up to Y=256 — worth seeking out for gold farming. Wearing gold armor prevents Piglins from attacking. Gold tools have terrible durability but excellent enchantability.
Drops 4-5 redstone dust per ore block. Fortune III can yield up to 8 dust. Shares its best depth with diamond — mining at Y=-59 will find both.

Sweet spot is Y=-54 to Y=-59. The old Y=11 advice is obsolete since 1.18. Sharing depth range with redstone and lapis means strip mining here is very efficient. More common in Jungle and Swamp biomes.

MOUNTAIN BIOMES ONLY (Windswept Hills, Stony Peaks, etc). Will not spawn in flat terrain no matter how deep you dig. Rarer than ancient debris per chunk. Spawns as single blocks — never multi-block veins.

nether_ores.notes: Very common in the Nether. Easy to farm. Gives decent XP.
Mining this ore angers nearby Piglins. Wear at least one piece of gold armor to prevent hostility. Fortune increases nugget drops.

uses: Combined with gold ingots to make Netherite Ingots
nether_ores.notes: The rarest ore in the game. Always fully buried — never exposed in cave walls or lava pools. Blast-resistant (immune to most explosions). Common strategy: TNT mining or placing beds and exploding them at Y=16. Requires 4 Netherite Scrap + 4 Gold Ingots per Netherite Ingot on a smithing table.

key_crafting_chains.iron_progression: Iron Ore -> Smelt -> Iron Ingot -> Craft Iron Pickaxe/Sword/Armor/Shield
key_crafting_chains.diamond_progression: Diamond Ore (iron pick required) -> Diamond -> Craft Diamond Tools/Armor -> Enchanting Table (3 diamonds + 2 obsidian + book)
key_crafting_chains.netherite_progression: Ancient Debris (diamond pick) -> Smelt -> Netherite Scrap (x4) + Gold Ingots (x4) -> Netherite Ingot -> Smithing Table + Diamond Gear + Netherite Upgrade Template = Netherite Gear
key_crafting_chains.enchanting_table: Requires: 3 Diamonds + 2 Obsidian + 1 Book. Needs Lapis Lazuli to operate.
key_crafting_chains.lapis_for_enchanting: Lapis Lazuli ore (stone pick) -> Lapis Lazuli -> Required per enchantment at enchanting table
